Headquarters: Illinois, USA, Remote; Texas, USA, Remote

As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the technical strategy across your accounts as a peer to the Account Executive - a standing weekly 1:1 with each AE you support, and a standing weekly account team call with the full ecosystem where you carry POV status, technical blockers, and the explanation behind any usage movement.

• Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.

• Lead discovery in every meeting, not only in discovery meetings - including meetings where you were invited to present. Leave each meeting knowing something about their business you did not know going in.

• Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, solution workshops, etc. that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes for diverse stakeholder audiences including executives 

• Full ownership of the technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining competitive success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process

• Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond

• Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams

• Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems 

• Identify and proactively resolve technical and organizational blockers by collaborating across Product, Support, and GTM teams before customers are impacted

• Contribute to team enablement by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and creating reusable assets that scale knowledge across the region

Who You Are: 

• 7+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment

• Skilled at influencing and adapting communication across technical, business, and executive audiences 

• Advanced background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences

• Experience displacing or consolidating away from an entrenched incumbent inside an account where that incumbent has internal advocates

• A consultative, outcome - oriented approach to problem-solving and customer engagement

• Demonstrated depth over breadth. You have worked a very small number of very large organisations over long horizons, and can describe how your understanding of one account compounded across quarters.

• Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement initiatives

• Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it 

• Growth mindset of embracing change and being curious 

• Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits and Growth: 

• Best-in-breed onboarding

• Generous global benefits

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks 

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.
The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:
$149,000—$198,000 USD

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. About the Role: 

Maven is looking for a Director, GTM Operations & Architecture will own the strategy, systems, design, and reporting that power Maven's commercial engine. This role sits at the center of Salesforce administration, accountable for the business requirements and sales processes that drive it, providing the growth team with clean, trusted data and efficient workflows. You will report to the Head of Revenue Operations and partner closely with Salesforce engineering, Commercial Strategy, Sales, and Finance to keep our systems scalable, well-documented, and built for growth.

This is a player-coach role. You will have 1-2 direct reports while retaining end-to-end ownership of a few critical domains. The person in this seat will be the functional owner of our GTM tools and processes: defining what the business needs, translating those needs into system requirements, owning prioritization, and driving projects to completion. We are looking for a builder and an operator.

What You’ll Do:

Salesforce & GTM Systems Ownership: The Director will own Salesforce as the system of record for the GTM org, ensuring the platform is configured, automated, and maintained to support the sales process end to end

• Owns the roadmap and end-to-end CRM strategy for Salesforce and adjacent systems

• Develops deep fluency in how Sales, Finance, and Analytics use our GTM systems — the decisions they drive, the reports and fields they depend on, and the obstacles they face

• Translates strategic and operational workflows into clear business and functional requirements, partnering with Salesforce engineering to deliver solutions that meet the needs of the business

• Owns a clean, well-documented sales funnel model — pipeline stages, opportunity fields, account hierarchies — and maps data across systems

• Leads AI strategy within the Salesforce ecosystem, identifying and building automation that reduces manual work

• Troubleshoots system issues quickly and is the first point of escalation for sales tooling problems

Data Quality & Process Governance: The Director is the steward of data quality and process discipline across our GTM systems

• Runs regular data hygiene audits — duplicate records, stale opportunities, missing fields — and drives resolution with sales teams

• Owns QA through the deal lifecycle, from S1 opportunities to go-live — validating products, pricing, and contract terms against Salesforce before a deal is handed off to implementation

• Defines, governs, and maintains the business rules for Maven's customer account hierarchy, including new accounts, restructures, and ongoing hygiene, to support accurate reporting and client operations

• Documents and enforces sales process standards (stage definitions, required fields, deal desk workflows) so the pipeline reflects reality

Cross-Functional Operations Support: The Director is a hands-on operator across the broader GTM and Finance functions

• Partners with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Engineering to identify bottlenecks and convert them into system-level solutions

• Drives business analysis and program management for Salesforce-related initiatives, including scoping new requests, running discovery, and managing multi-phase implementation roadmaps

• Supports Deal Desk with opportunity structuring, approval workflows, new pricing, and contract data accuracy in Salesforce

What You’ll Bring: 

• 8+ years across Salesforce architecture, revenue operations, or GTM systems, including time at a B2B SaaS or healthcare company

• Deep hands-on Salesforce skill: Understands best-practice system architecture and can design clear business and system requirements to achieve that build. Has designed account hierarchies and object models for complex B2B organizations, ideally where revenue moves through more than one channel or contract structure

• Has built their own automation and AI-enabled tooling to replace manual GTM and revenue operations work; continually identifies inefficient processes and eliminates them

• Has integrated Salesforce with the systems around it — data warehouse, BI, billing, and GTM tooling. At Maven this means Looker, BigQuery, NetSuite, Gong, ZoomInfo, and Clay

• Proficient in Looker or equivalent BI, with a track record of owning recurring reporting and QA that other teams depend on

• Can take an ambiguous request, run discovery, and come back with a scoped, multi-phase plan — and can hold a room of senior stakeholders to a decision once it’s made

• Writes clearly, and can turn an architecture decision into documentation a sales leader and an engineer can both use

• Ready to build and lead a team while remaining a deeply hands-on operator

Strong Preference For:

• Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials, or the designer certifications that ladder into them (Data Architecture & Management, Sharing & Visibility, Integration Architecture)

• Familiarity with Apex and sound judgment on when custom code is warranted over configuration

• Experience at a high-growth healthcare or healthcare benefits company

• Has run a migration or system consolidation end to end, including the unglamorous parts: de-duplication, cleansing, bulk loads

The base salary range for this role is $204,000 - $230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

ee030ac64ababeff.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About the team
Razorpay is India's leading full-stack payments and financial services company. The SME Payments Group owns the end-to-end experience for small and medium businesses across 14 product pods: onboarding, activation, payments, dashboard, growth and AI-native products.

Onboarding Infra is the platform layer under every merchant's first mile. It runs sign-up and identity, KYC and verification, and the workflow and state systems that take a business from sign-up to live payments while keeping Razorpay compliant with RBI and CKYC norms. It also powers agentic onboarding: RAY, our AI assistant, verifies and activates merchants through this team's APIs.

You will own a platform whose consumers are other product teams, AI agents and regulators as much as merchants.

What you'll own
You will own six platform areas end to end, with a senior engineering team of principal, staff and senior engineers.

Area
What it covers
Sign-up and identity
Sign-up, login and user and merchant creation across email, mobile and Google
KYC and verification
CKYC, video KYC; world class OCR platforms; KYC partnerships
Onboarding workflows and state
The workflow engine and state machine behind merchant KYC and periodic re-KYC; event-driven state sync to downstream systems
Data privacy and segregation
PII vaulting, consent, and clean separation of data and services across legal entities
Agentic onboarding rails
The APIs, tools and guardrails that let an AI agent verify and activate a merchant safely
Platform reliability
SLOs, incident load, support tickets caused by system issues, and test coverage, owned jointly with engineering

Role: ETL Developer
Key Skills: Informatica, Databricks
Experience: 5 - 8 years
Position Summary:
We are seeking an experienced ETL Developer with expertise in Informatica and Databricks to design, develop, optimize, and support enterprise data integration solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, integrating data from multiple source systems, and enabling high-quality, reliable data delivery for analytics, reporting, and business decision-making. This role requires hands-on experience with modern data platforms, strong SQL skills, and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL/ELT workflows using Informatica and Databricks.
• Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data
• Extract data from multiple source systems such as databases, flat files, APIs, and cloud platforms
• Transform and load data into enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, or lakehouse environments
• Develop reusable data integration components and framework-based solutions
• Optimize pipeline performance, job scheduling, and resource utilization
• Perform data profiling, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation to ensure data quality
• Troubleshoot production issues and provide ongoing support for data integration jobs
• Collaborate with data architects and business teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
• Implement logging, monitoring, error handling, and recovery mechanisms in ETL processes
• Work with cloud and big data technologies to support large-scale data processing
• Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and best practices
• Participate in code reviews, release management, and technical documentation

Required Skills and Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
• Proven experience as an ETL Developer, Data Engineer, or similar role
• Strong experience with Databricks, including notebook development and workflow orchestration
• Proficiency in SQL and relational databases such as Oracle or SQL Server
• Experience with Python, PySpark, or Spark SQL
• Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and ETL best practices
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure.
• Familiarity with file formats such as CSV, JSON, XML etc
• Knowledge of job scheduling and orchestration tools like Autosys is good to have
• Knowledge on Informatica PowerCenter and/or Informatica Cloud Services
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and performance tuning skills
• Good communication and collaboration skills

ee5cd81921480440.description:
The MongoDB Documentation team is a group of writers and engineers who develop and maintain the documentation for the MongoDB product family. Our goal is to help our readers, both humans and AI, successfully use MongoDB products by providing outstanding documentation. The MongoDB Documentation team is a part of the MongoDB Core Product organization and is tightly integrated with the engineering teams responsible for each product. We are hiring a Manager Technical Writer to guide the creation of world-class documentation for the MongoDB data platform.

You will use your leadership skills to manage and grow a talented team of writers, prioritize and plan documentation projects, and influence the strategic vision for the MongoDB docs. Your AI-forward mindset coupled with strong writing and technical skills will guide production of clear reference docs and tutorials on high-complexity features. Your team’s work, along with the other two MongoDB Docs teams, support AI agents, answer engines, and a large global community of new and experienced MongoDB users.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model.

Candidate Profile

Candidates must have extensive technical writing experience and 2+ years of experience managing a team of technical writers, developer advocates, or other technical communications-focused roles. Beyond that, we are looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about developing writing expertise on a team through reviews and mentorship
  • Has experience prioritizing and planning documentation projects
  • Works collaboratively with other documentation leaders and writers
  • Grew a technical writing team through interviewing, hiring, and onboarding talented writers
  • Has hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate documentation work
  • Leverages sound editorial judgment to evaluate AI-generated content against source material for technical accuracy
  • Possesses strong critical reading and writing skills
  • Has experience with cloud and database technologies
  • Is able to write code for technical examples in at least one programming language (e.g., C++, C#, Java, Python, JavaScript). Comfortable reading and interpreting code

Position Expectations

  • Lead a technical writing team with opportunity for team growth
  • Integrate with a highly collaborative, globally distributed group of documentation leaders to build a strong cross-functional documentation team
  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Design, Developer Relations, and Product Marketing to ensure the documentation meets the needs of our users
  • Guide the team's adoption of AI-assisted research, writing, and review workflows, ensuring quality and technical accuracy remain high
  • Foster a positive and effective team culture
  • Develop the writing, testing, and technical skills of the team through coaching
  • Contribute feedback to the team through copy review and planning discussions
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product on the team’s roadmap
  • Interview and hire talented writers for all areas of the MongoDB Docs team
  • Advocate for users in everything your team produces
  • Produce technically accurate and well-written documentation when time permits

In 3 months:

  • You've met with all of your team members and are starting to learn their interests, strengths, and areas for development
  • You’ve become comfortable with our toolchain, AI tooling, and writing workflow
  • You're getting to know our partners in Engineering and Product Management
  • You’re getting comfortable with participating in intra and inter team discussions
  • You've completed any required technical and leadership training required for the MongoDB Product team

In 6 months:

  • You review your team’s work and are using their writing to learn more about the MongoDB data platform
  • You've adapted to our style of writing and instill technical writing best practices in team members’ work
  • You have worked with each team member to develop a growth plan tailored to their career goals
  • You and your manager have discussed your career trajectory and growth opportunities
  • You've developed a working knowledge of MongoDB's products and know who to follow up with when you need to learn more
  • You've helped the team improve and establish effective, well-vetted AI-assisted workflows for drafting and review

In 12 months:

  • You're actively guiding the team to produce consistently high quality documentation for enterprise architectures, entire feature sets, complex tutorials, and high level concepts
  • You know how much work your team can manage and are delivering content at a healthy pace
  • You provide expert copy and technical reviews for your team members
  • You provide best practices and coaching on AI-assisted workflows for your team members

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
